name: io.github.artgas1/max-mcp-server
title: MAX messenger
description: MAX messenger (max.ru) personal account: read chats, history, search, media. Read-only by default.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Profile name (one MAX account per profile). Log in first: uvx max-mcp-server login qr

environmentVariables.name: MAX_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to register write tools (still need MAX_WRITE_CHATS)

environmentVariables.name: MAX_READ_CHATS
environmentVariables.description: Read allowlist: comma-separated chat ids (empty = all chats)

environmentVariables.name: MAX_WRITE_CHATS
environmentVariables.description: Write allowlist: comma-separated chat ids, * for all (empty = no writes)

environmentVariables.name: MAX_TZ
environmentVariables.description: Time zone for dates, e.g. Europe/Moscow
